Hi Oxygen,


Reading through your application, I have a few pros and cons for you:


Pros:
1. You are indeed a helpful guy.
2. The time periods of which you are free is perfect as those are the times where the knife server players tend to fluctuate.
3. Your layout is relatively good.


However, I'm afraid there are more cons:
1. You do not meet the age requirement.
2. You are barely, if not, never active on our TeamSpeak3 server.
3. Your activity in-game is also lacking.
4. One of your weaknesses would be attention to detail as you have alot of grammatical and spelling errors.
5. Your level of maturity is questionable from the incident just a couple of days ago - Admins need to be able to control their feelings when dealing with problems (not get too aggravated which I know you sometimes will get carried away by).
6. I would say that your punishment to players verbally abusing is a bit harsh. I would personally kick, and then ban for an hour, slowly increasing it if they repeat the same offence.
7. Your English skills, I would say, is only at a "Good" level.


Overall, I'm afraid its a NO from me because of those negative reasons. If you was to not succeed with this application, would suggest that you apply after the cool down period (you have to wait a month before you can attempt to apply again) and that you use that time to improve what I have listed my cons list.


However, I wish you the best of luck.


~ Doo Doo

Hello Oxygen,


I'm glad to see that you want to get involved a bit more in the Dream community. We have played around 5-6 times together already, however, I'm not so active like before for now but I am still active.


But, I'm going to copy and paste with some adjustments what I write to Bornato and Hux (that never join Dream knife anymore because Dream staff said no, I'm glad that they didn't become admin but they still should've tried 1 or 2 months later but they quit as a whole).


For me, it is too early to see you as a mature sense of person (you need to be mature at all times for admin) and you are making the same mistake by applying for admin too early.
If you are new to a job, you're not going to ask for a pay rise after 1 week or 1 month of work.


What about the Application Requirements?
1) You must be at least 16 years old ----> 16 is already too young in my opinion to become admin so I think 16 is a minimum.
2) You need to have frequent activity in our community (TeamSpeak3, in-game and Forums wise) - didn't see you?
3. You need many stamm/rank points. 2k stamm points is not much at all.


One more thing, i saw that the subject of the thread is "Try my luck." It think it’s not luck, it's requirements, time and the knowledge and respect of the community.


You get a NO from me, but I hope you will play on the server more and re-try with your application later on. You said you were close to being 16 years of age so I guess you'll reach a higher stamm points when you reach 16 if you continue to be active in-game, and ultimately, you'll have more knowledge of the community, the players, and the forum.



aX.

Hi Oxygen,


I'm fully agreeing with the other opinions in the thread.
I'm not so sure whether you can be mature or not. You got two bans for insulting people in your playtime already, one from me and one from Doo Doo.
It's certaintly possible to change your behavior, but I don't know if you can really do it consistently in that short amount of time. Unfortunately, I see very big potential of you either Admin Abusing or insulting other players, especially as an admin, where they are not able do much against you and you can just kick / ban them.


Another thing speaking against you, is your uncertainty about your application. I've heard from people who told me that you asked them to comment something positive about your application, which is a complete no go for me. That's kind of against the rules and seems like begging to me.


The last thing I want to mention is, that you shouldn't try to sweet talk people. At first it seemed kind of nice for me but now I get that feeling that you tell people how nice they are and how good of an admin they are and other nice things, just so they see you in a different light and might consider you as a nicer guy than you maybe are.


In conclusion, I would suggest waiting 1-2 months (maybe when you are 16) and then try reapplying again. It then shows us that you are not just some guy longing for admin rights but that you are genuinely interested in the community and can stick around for sometime. Waiting also gives you the opportunity to let more people know you and allows ourselves to get a better picture of you as a person.


Therefore I have to give you a No for now.


Greetings
